messages:
Nora Li: Hey team, quick access issue on my first day. I can sign into Okta and 1Password, but opening our team Drive 'model-checkpoints' gives 403. Joined via the onboarding flow an hour ago. Anyone know who owns that share? :sweat_smile:
Priya Patel: Welcome Nora! Can you paste the folder link and confirm the account shown in Drive (top-right)?
Nora Li: Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ModelCheckpointsExample. Drive shows nora.li@redwood.com.
it-provisioning-bot: Provisioning log: okta_user_created nora.li@redwood.com at 2026-04-05T11:12:10Z; google_workspace_account_ready at 2026-04-05T11:13:05Z; 1Password_invite sent.
Samir Rao: New hires start in 'eng-onboard' group. That folder is shared to 'eng-models'. If the promotion job didn't run you get a 403.
Priya Patel: I'll add you to eng-models now and file a ticket for the sync.
Nora Li: Thanks! After you add me do I need to refresh anything?
Samir Rao: Usually immediate but Drive can cache. Try incognito or a hard refresh if it still shows 403 after a minute.
Priya Patel: Added nora.li@redwood.com to eng-models. Filed ticket IT-4882: "onboard-group-promote failed for subset; rotate token and rerun sync."
Nora Li: Incognito worked 1 I can open it now  huge thanks. Quick extra Q: my Okta MFA shows "Passkey not registered" but I did the flow. Should I re-register or contact security?
Priya Patel: Try re-registering under Profile -> Extra Verification Methods first. We had one transient passkey registration failure earlier this week; a retry usually fixes it. If re-register fails ping me and I'll escalate to security.
